messages:
incident_bot: ALERT: Increased gateway timeouts and 5xx from model-serving-runtime in us-east-1. Error rate increased to 9% since 1778954280. Auto-escalation: paging on-call.

rachel_oncall: I'm taking the page. Paging @dev_ops and @nina_runtime for runtime triage. Any recent config changes?

deploy-bot: No deployments in the last 45m. Canary rollout complete at 1778954000.

dev_ops: seeing repeated JNI aborts in model-runner when heavy batched streaming happens. Collecting pod logs + core dumps.

nina_runtime: grabbing logs now. Pattern: memory grows steadily on affected pods; GC doesn't free KV cache; eventually allocation fails and process crashes.

chris_infra: affected nodes: node-ae9 (gpu-a100-1), node-be3 (gpu-a100-2). GPU mem usage climbs to 98% then OOM kill.

nina_runtime: log snippet:
```
I0401 14:04:40.111 start handling request batch id=bd42 size=28
I0401 14:04:40.235 kv_cache reserve 12.5GB current=2.1GB
I0401 14:04:41.542 allocated 10.3GB
I0401 14:05:00.499 allocation failed: std::bad_alloc at kv_manager.cpp:518
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
*** Aborted at 1680363900 (signal 6) ***
```

dev_ops: core dump attached to pod: model-runner-abc-0. Uploading to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1778954321/

izzy_sre: mitigation proposals: 1) enable model-fallback to quantized-medium for streaming customers; 2) enable per-request batch size cap to avoid large batch spikes; 3) shift heavy tenants to eu or us-west while we patch.

sam_cs: impacted customers reported: streamlabs (severe truncation of streams, ~20% of requests truncated), ledgerly (batch jobs failing intermittently), retailx (increased latency). We should send an incident notice.

rachel_oncall: executing short-term mitigations: applying batch-size cap and fallback routing for streaming route.

dev_ops: applying rate limit + batch cap via gateway:
```bash
redwood gateway update --route streaming --max-batch 16 --qps 200 --region us-east-1
```

incident_bot: Gateway update applied. Monitoring for changes.

chris_infra: also spinning up 3 spare nodes as hot replacements in us-east-1.

nina_runtime: injecting a canary patch to add explicit KV cache eviction for idle shards. Patch diff:
```diff
- if (idle_time > 30s) keep_kv
+ if (idle_time > 10s) evict_kv_partial()
```
Deployed to canary pod model-runner-canary-2.

dev_ops: canary exercising with synthetic workload: 600 concurrent short streams + occasional big batch. Observing no mem climb after patch. No crashes in 6 minutes.

sam_cs: status update sent to impacted tenants: "We've detected elevated timeouts in us-east-1. We've throttled large batches and routed streaming to a fallback model; investigating runtime memory growth. We'll follow up once stabilized."

incident_bot: error rate decreased to 1.7% within 10 minutes of mitigation. Truncation reports decreased.

izzy_sre: proposal for post-incident: add per-tenant batch histogram, KV cache retention metric, and an automated eviction trigger when node GPU mem > 85%. Also add an alert for sustained pre-OOM allocation failures.

nina_runtime: root cause hypothesis: stale KV shards not being freed when batches interleave with streaming sessions; long-tail batch requests trigger huge preallocs and leak on some code paths, culminating in OOM and abort.

dev_ops: plan: merge canary patch after 30m of stability, and run a scaling test with synthetic large batches to confirm. Also add a runtime guard to reject requests with batch_size > 64 for now.

chris_infra: new nodes healthy, no OOM-killer events since mitigations.

rachel_oncall: marking timeline: detection 14:04, mitigations (batch-cap + fallback + node scale) 14:09-14:18, canary patch 14:22, stabilization observed by 14:35.

sam_cs: CS follow-up: offer replays for failed batch jobs to Ledgerly and a post-incident call with Streamlabs.

izzy_sre: creating incident ticket and assigning owners: nina_runtime (root cause & fix), dev_ops (rollout safeguards), chris_infra (auto-scale+node alert tuning), sam_cs (customer comms).

incident_bot: Incident logged: severity=sev2, impacted_regions=[us-east-1], mitigations=[batch-cap, fallback-routing, node-scale, runtime-canary], state=stabilized.

rachel_oncall: nice work. Will keep monitoring for 60m then hand off to owners for postmortem.

(reacts: :eyes: by nina_runtime, :white_check_mark: by dev_ops)
